name: CSManager
description: CSManager is a Windows application for browsing, searching, and editing crystal structure databases: AMCSD is bundled, COD is downloaded on demand, CIF/AMC files can be imported and exported, and crystals can be sent to ReciPro and PDIndexer.

paragraphs: CSManager is a Windows desktop application for browsing, searching, and maintaining crystal structure databases. It is designed for crystallography workflows where you want to work with a large local structure database, inspect individual crystals in detail, import external structure files, and exchange data with related tools.
The application ships with an AMCSD database, can download and load COD on demand, and provides a combined UI for search, table-based browsing, and crystal editing.
